GitHub API is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2026.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [Gists search](@/work/gists-search.md): A searchable index over a mirror of my GitHub gists; [github-extractor](@/work/github-extractor.md): Extracts Data From Github.

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses GitHub API: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links GitHub API to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
